filament-profile.downloading: Downloading the Prusa profiles. This takes a minute the first time.
filament-profile.empty.title: No filament is loaded on this printer
filament-profile.empty.body: Assign a material to a tool in the Materials extension, then come back.
filament-profile.name: Profile name
filament-profile.printerOnly: The Materials extension is not available, so the profiles start from the type of material the printer reports. Rename each profile, and use the search to find a preset by brand. Temperatures from the maker are not available.
filament-profile.importHint: In PrusaSlicer 2.9: File → Import → Import Config Bundle. The printer is selected, and each profile is the filament of its tool, in the printer's order (Tool 1 is filament 1).
filament-profile.slotGap: Tool 1 is not included, so PrusaSlicer will keep its current filament selection.
filament-profile.fault.NO_CATALOGUE: The Prusa profiles are not downloaded yet.
filament-profile.fault.NO_PRESET: That preset or printer variant is not in the Prusa profiles.
filament-profile.fault.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The Prusa profiles could not be downloaded.
filament-profile.fault.noMaterials: The Materials extension is not installed, or does not follow this printer.
filament-profile.printerHint: The profiles are the ones PrusaSlicer offers for this printer, and the file selects it when you import.
filament-profile.needPrinter: Choose the printer to see the presets that fit it.
filament-profile.adaptedNote: This preset is not made for this printer: its temperatures, fan and retraction are laid over the printer's generic preset. Check them before printing.
filament-profile.nozzleDiffers: This tool has a {tool} nozzle, but the printer preset is {printer}. The profile follows the printer preset.
filament-profile.fewExtruders: This printer preset has {count} extruder(s): the tools above that number are not selected in PrusaSlicer.
filament-profile.noResultsFit: No preset that fits this printer matches “{query}”.
filament-profile.foundFit: {count} preset(s) found that fit this printer.
filament-profile.foundAny: {count} preset(s) found. Choose a printer to see which fit.
filament-profile.noFit: No Prusa preset fits this printer for this spool. Search for another preset or pick another printer.
